limitations: The frozen feature is observed before Transformer/AOSC context; changes can still arise from streaming frontend state and target frame alignment. The reused Task 09B threshold was calibrated on grouped 3-second queries, while context checks use individual full query clips.

protocol.aosc_import: uses the existing Task 09B research profile fixture built from training speakers; no AOSC context is required to construct the frozen profile
protocol.feature_comparison: matching target-relative frame IDs are compared separately from pooled representation and identity decisions to expose frontend or boundary changes
protocol.same_speaker_prior_turn: for each target, the other disjoint query utterance from that same evaluation speaker is streamed first, followed by 250ms silence; same-speaker grouping is an oracle context stress test, not a deployable turn-association rule
protocol.threshold: one fixed Task 09B calibration threshold per fold; applied unchanged to fresh and contextual queries

representation: frozen pre_encoder mean with Task 09B training-speaker-only per-dimension z-score; one profile per arbitrary external speaker ID
